name: Bootstrap qualification 995 v5 bundle

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/bootstrap-qualification-995-v5.yml

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: bootstrap-qualification-995-v5
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  bootstrap:
    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Materialize reviewed qualification v5 bundle
        env:
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.head_ref }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if test -f .github/workflows/complete-history-12-slot-qualification-995-v5.yml; then
            echo 'qualification v5 bundle already materialized'
            exit 0
          fi
          cat > /tmp/qualification-v5.tar.gz.b64 <<'PAYLOAD'

PAYLOAD
          base64 -d /tmp/qualification-v5.tar.gz.b64 > /tmp/qualification-v5.tar.gz
          tar -xzf /tmp/qualification-v5.tar.gz -C .
          rm -f .github/workflows/bootstrap-qualification-995-v5.yml
          git config user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          git add -A
          git commit -m 'Stage history-recovered qualification 995 v5'
          git push origin "HEAD:${HEAD_REF}"
